chunks: And ‘Ali ibn Muḥammad ibn Qūlawayh narrated to me from Aḥmad ibn Idrīs, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ‘Isā, from Ibn Faḍḍāl, from Ibn Abī ‘Umayr, from al-Ḥusayn ibn ‘Uthmān, from someone whose name he mentioned, from Abū ‘Abdillāh (peace be upon him) who said:
Drops fall into the Euphrates every day from Paradise.
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual significance of the Euphrates River according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Imam al-Ṣādiq (peace be upon him) narrates that every day, drops of water fall from Paradise into the Euphrates River, a tradition that underscores the river's unique spiritual status in Shia eschatology and jurisprudence. This celestial connection elevates the Euphrates beyond a mere geographical feature, marking it as a source of barakah and a sign of divine favor for the faithful who drink from or perform ghusl in its waters.
